entries.clue: "The Name of the Game" pop quartet
Cookie used to make Halloween bat-shaped treats
Date night, or a midgame show starring Beyoncé instead of the coach's nephew's garage band?
Bohr played by Kenneth Branagh in "Oppenheimer"
Bolsa Chica State Beach's locale, informally
Giving up a lazy Saturday to clean up a beach at sunrise, or waking up to pancakes instead of gruel?
A chic gray bob and cat eye bifocals, or sleeping until noon and dancing until dawn?
Cardstock instead of newsprint, or the work of a wordy student?
"The copy editor says this needs a capital letter," or a judge saying "Not enough evidence" in a bass-baritone?
God's rest on the seventh day, or forty winks on a bunk bed?
